summary: feat(db-migrations): add limitSessions_4, sparing device sessions
description:
Because:
- limitSessions_3 deletes the oldest sessions first, often Sync devices,
  and skips the auth-server's device disconnect side effects.

This commit:
- Adds limitSessions_4: deviceless sessions go first, devices only after.
- Returns the devices it deletes (id, refreshTokenId) as a result set.
- Counts only session tokens in totalDeletions.
- Adds the test copy and bumps the fxa target patch to 202.

Closes FXA-14945
